statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-8763 (GHSA-9pwp-9qqc-pr26): Bouncy Castle's name-constraint check (PKIXNameConstraintValidator) can be bypassed by a trailing dot in an rfc822Name or URI, so a certificate can name a host or address that its issuer's name constraints exclude. bcprov-jdk18on before 1.85 is affected, and 1.85 carries the fix: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-9pwp-9qqc-pr26, https://github.com/bcgit/bc-java/wiki/CVE%E2%80%902026%E2%80%908763, https://github.com/bcgit/bc-java/commit/2c28b253a44681fbbc562561eab6ad383d2ae558 (first released in 1.85, not in 1.84). We read every published gradle-8 package for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository (16 versions, 8.14.4-r0 to 8.14.8-r0; the x86_64 and aarch64 packages of each version are byte-identical, and 8.14.5-r4 is published for x86_64 only), each matching its repository index checksum, and searched every jar and zip in them, nested archives and META-INF/versions directories included, for the affected PKIXNameConstraintValidator class under any package path. It is present only in Gradle's bundled /usr/share/java/gradle/lib/plugins/bcprov-jdk18on-<version>.jar, as org/bouncycastle/asn1/x509/PKIXNameConstraintValidator.class and the org/bouncycastle/jce/provider class of the same name; no other jar in these packages holds a copy, relocated or not. Builds 8.14.4-r0 to 8.14.4-r3 ship bcprov-jdk18on 1.78.1, 8.14.5-r3 to 8.14.5-r8 ship 1.84, and 8.14.5-r9 and every later build, through 8.14.8-r0, ship 1.85. As a check, the org/bouncycastle/asn1/x509 class in every 1.85 jar references stripTrailingDot, the helper the fix applies to rfc822Name and URI constraints, and the class in every earlier jar does not. The range ends at 8.14.5-r9, the first build with bcprov-jdk18on 1.85.

CVE-2026-8763 (GHSA-9pwp-9qqc-pr26): Bouncy Castle's name-constraint check (PKIXNameConstraintValidator) compared rfc822Name and URI hosts without stripping a trailing dot, so a certificate could name a host or address that its issuer's name constraints exclude. bcprov-jdk18on before 1.85 is affected, and 1.85 carries the fix: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-9pwp-9qqc-pr26, https://github.com/bcgit/bc-java/wiki/CVE%E2%80%902026%E2%80%908763, https://github.com/bcgit/bc-java/commit/2c28b253a44681fbbc562561eab6ad383d2ae558 (in the r1rv85 release tag, not in r1rv84). Read every published gradle-9 package for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository, x86_64 and aarch64 (9.4.0-r0 to 9.9.2-r0; 9.6.1-r3 and 9.6.1-r4 are published for x86_64 only), checking each download against the index checksum and recursing into every jar. In each build the only jars with org.bouncycastle classes are bcprov-jdk18on, bcpg-jdk18on and bcutil-jdk18on under /usr/share/java/gradle/lib/plugins; versions are taken from the Bundle-Version in each jar's manifest. bcprov-jdk18on is 1.81 in 9.4.0-r0 to 9.4.1-r2, 1.84 in 9.5.0-r2 to 9.7.0-r1, 1.85 in 9.7.1-r0 to 9.8.2-r1, and 1.86 (a reduced bcprov-jdk18on-1.86-min.jar, which still contains org.bouncycastle.asn1.x509.PKIXNameConstraintValidator) in 9.9.0-r0 to 9.9.2-r0. In every build from 9.7.1-r0 on, the compiled org.bouncycastle.asn1.x509.PKIXNameConstraintValidator class calls stripTrailingDot from isEmailConstrained and isURIConstrained, which is the change the fix makes (checked by disassembling the class from bcprov 1.85 and 1.86-min; every build with the same bcprov version ships byte-identical class files). In every earlier build the class contains no stripTrailingDot at all. The org.bouncycastle.jce.provider.PKIXNameConstraintValidator class in the same jar delegates to it. The range ends at 9.7.1-r0, the first build with bcprov 1.85.
